response.sql: WITH per_currency AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(NULLIF(rebtotal, 0)) AS avg_rebate, AVG(CASE WHEN rebrate <> 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0) END) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS mean_rebate FROM per_currency) SELECT AVG(p.avg_rebate) AS avg_rebate, AVG(p.avg_relative_gap) AS avg_relative_gap, AVG(p.avg_rebate - b.mean_rebate) AS avg_excess_rebate FROM per_currency AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_rebate > b.mean_rebate;
